subject: Prod-like Environment Activation & Network Acceptance — Preflight & Ops Handoff
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@scaleworks.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Oct 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prod-like environment activation kickoff (Acme Health)

Hi Soojin + team,

Thanks again — Acme Health is ready to move their VPC-connected private deployment into the prod-like activation phase. Our ops team has compiled the initial network diagram and a short list of gating items. We'd like to confirm Redwood's requirements and schedule a handoff call early next week to walk the topology and visibility hooks.

High level asks:
- Confirm public egress IPs for allowlist and expected TLS cert fingerprints.
- Validate service account access patterns for S3/KMS integrations.
- Agree on audit/logging endpoints (syslog/CloudWatch) and retention minima.

Attached: acme_network-diagram-v2.pdf (diagram), initial SOW draft (sow-acme-v1.docx).

Proposed times (PDT): Mon 10/21 10:00–11:00, Tue 10/22 15:00–16:00.

Can you confirm who from Redwood will take the technical walk and who owns the post-call tasks?

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Solutions Engineer, ScaleWorks

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@scaleworks.com>, prodops@acmehealth.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Oct 2024 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prod-like environment activation kickoff (Acme Health)

Hi Olivia — thanks for the diagram and SOW.

We can run the technical walk and validate the gating items. Proposed internal owners:
- Tech lead / topology: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com)
- Security & certs: Kimberly Park (kimberly_park@redwood.com)
- Program / SOW updates: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com)

Ben, Kim — can you both join the call?

Quick prelim notes so the call is focused:
- We require a static egress IP block for connection back to our control plane and for third-party integrations. We will provide a /28 range for allowlisting during activation.
- Service accounts: we prefer short-lived STS roles with per-environment service accounts and least privilege. We will send an roles matrix before the call.
- Logging: We can ship audit logs to a customer-managed syslog endpoint (TLS) or collect to CloudWatch; we need the retention target (default: 90 days) and whether transfer uses a proxy.

I attached our Redwood ops preflight checklist (redwood-ops-preflight-checklist.xlsx) for items we usually verify during activation. Please review before the call.

Available for Mon 10/21 10:00 PDT. If that works for Acme, I'll send a calendar invite and an agenda.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Manager, Private Deployments — Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-ops-preflight-checklist.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@scaleworks.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Oct 2024 14:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prod-like environment activation kickoff (Acme Health)

+1 to Monday at 10:00 PDT. I'll lead the topology walkthrough.

Preflight technical checklist (short):
- VPC peering / TGW: confirm route propagation and that the Acme spoke subnets do not overlap with Redwood management ranges (we'll list the management CIDRs on the call).
- NAT/Egress: need the static egress block from Redwood for webhook callbacks and health checks; if Acme routes through a corporate proxy, we need its IP and proxy auth method.
- DNS: We'll need to validate the internal DNS zones and the certificate issuance flow (ACME vs. internal CA).
- KV cache endpoints: if you host a customer-side cache, please confirm connection TLS settings and session timeout (default 30m).

I attached a marked-up version of the network diagram with suggested firewall rules (acme_network-diagram-v2.pdf, annotated).

--
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: acme_network-diagram-v2.pdf (annotated)

From: prodops@acmehealth.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: olivia.park@scaleworks.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Oct 2024 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prod-like environment activation kickoff (Acme Health)

Thanks — Mon 10/21 10:00 works for us. A couple clarifications before the call:

- We will accept the /28 egress block during activation windows but need the specific IPs at least 48 hours prior for our SOC change window.
- For KMS: Acme will provide a customer-managed key in our account; we need to confirm any required key policies to allow Redwood's managed services to encrypt/decrypt.
- Audit logs: We prefer push to customer-managed syslog (TLS) with a 180-day retention. We will provide the endpoint and cert during the call.

A small ask: can Redwood confirm whether the default token TTL for service accounts will be <= 15m? Our security team prefers short-lived tokens.

Regards,
Acme ProdOps

Attachments: none

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: prodops@acmehealth.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Oct 2024 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prod-like environment activation kickoff (Acme Health)

Thanks for the confirmations — agenda and calendar invite sent for Mon 10/21 10:00 PDT (recurring placeholder for the activation window). Action items before the call:

1) Redwood: publish the /28 egress IP list by Fri 10/19 COB (owner: Ben Carter).
2) Redwood: confirm service account token TTL and role matrix (owner: Rishi Malhotra).
3) Acme: share KMS key ARN and syslog endpoint + cert at least 48 hours before call.
4) All: review attached preflight checklist and mark any nonstandard items in the "notes" column (owner: Marissa Cole will consolidate).

I'll capture minutes and owners during the call and submit the activation runbook for approval. If anything changes on the Acme side (maintenance windows, firewall constraints) please flag before Friday.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Manager, Private Deployments — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-ops-preflight-checklist.xlsx (final)
